title: 极简扁平
referenceRole: style-only screenshot captured from the actual Showcase component section
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE new high-fidelity desktop Chinese B2B component-library visual direction mockup for "Mono Design", inspired by the actual supplied StyleKit Minimalist Flat component screenshot.
INPUT IMAGE ROLE: Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Borrow its zero-radius geometry, pure black-white contrast, confident flat outline buttons, crisp 2px black rules and purposeful hot-pink accent. Do not reproduce its website, its Components/Cards content, giant cards or marketing layout. This is a new backend resource-management screen using that visual language.
Output: landscape flat front view, approximately 1600x1100 logical composition, sharp legible UI, no device frame or perspective.

Core visual language: immaculate pure-white #FFFFFF canvas, pure-black #000000 text and structure, ONE pink #FF3366 accent, no gray page backgrounds, no blur, no gradients, no drop shadows, no texture, no gloss, no rounded rectangular corners at all. Circular radios and switches may use their native circular geometry but cards, fields, buttons, labels and panels are sharp rectangular. Bold Chinese system sans-serif headings (PingFang SC / Noto Sans SC feel), normal-weight black body text and generous space between major groups. Make it intentional editorial Swiss design translated into a practical B2B application, not brutalism with oversized black frames everywhere. Strong hierarchy, thin row dividers, bolder group boundaries. Never put white body text on pink: pink buttons/selection use black text. Important labels have excellent contrast.

Composition: thin top specimen banner reads "D  极简扁平" with "MONO DESIGN / MINIMALIST FLAT". Below it, a complete resource-management app; below that a compact component-state specimen strip. The app has a narrow white left sidebar separated by a black rule, a center content region containing team tree and data table, and a right form specimen titled "新建资源". Same overall business structure as the earlier studies, not a dashboard of charts.

Left sidebar: simple "Mono" wordmark, menu labels "概览", "资源管理", "组件规范", "设置". Active resource item is a clean full black rectangle with white text, with no colored edge stripe. Use simple black outline icons.
Header: large bold title "资源管理", smaller black subtitle "管理团队资源与访问状态", black filled primary button "新增资源". A strong horizontal rule organizes the header. Toolbar: underline-style search with placeholder "搜索资源", a sharp boxed select "全部状态", an underline date-range field "2026/10/01 — 2026/10/31". Controls approximately 36-40px high with credible spacing, never enormous.
Body: team tree titled "团队" with "产品组", "设计组", "工程组"; show product group expanded with 2 children. Central resource table with four rows, checkbox selection, headers "资源名称", "负责人", "状态", "更新时间". Black table header with white text. Row names "设计规范 v1", "组件清单", "交付检查", "测试数据"; short Chinese owner names and October 2026 dates. One selected row uses SOLID pink background and black text. Other rows white with thin black horizontal dividers, no zebra gray. Status markers use clear text and simple icons such as check/dash, labels "已启用", "草稿", "已停用"; mostly outline black and white, not rainbow pills. Pagination "共 4 条", square page 1 black with white digit.
Right form: title "新建资源"; labeled fields "资源名称", "负责人", "资源分类". Use mostly underline-style form fields, pink focus underline on one, empty name has a black warning icon and error text "请填写资源名称" plus pink underline. Upload area "上传附件" with a restrained dashed black sharp rectangular boundary and file row "design-spec.pdf". Footer outline "取消" and black filled "保存". There is breathing room, consistent alignment, no nested rounded cards.

Bottom component specimen: one clean outlined region, white canvas, black-rule column divisions. Present black primary, outlined secondary, and pink accent buttons labeled "主要操作", "次要操作", "强调操作"; a visibly disabled outlined control labeled "不可用", underline inputs default/focus/error; square checkbox, radio, switch; a small sharp calendar headed "2026年10月" with one pink selected date and black text; compact outlined status tags. The focus state uses a visible pink outline or underline, no shadow glow. Native rounded radio/switch knobs are allowed for semantics; no rounded panels or pills. No long rule prose inside image, no unrelated decoration.
The result should feel substantially bolder, flatter and more typographically decisive than a generic gray SaaS dashboard, while retaining a usable, readable complex B2B layout. All major regions and bottom specimen visible without clipping.
